utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still on for check-in, just running a bit late. I’ll get people signed in and share the Sunday community center update when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: A drill, screwdriver set, and a few wrenches would help most. Thanks, Gus — that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be a huge help, thanks. If you spot any gloves or screwdrivers, set those aside too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — once you send the school times, I’ll lock in a Sunday slot at the community center and keep us clear of pickup and events.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll wait for your times, then I’ll confirm the Sunday slot at the community center and keep the schedule clear of pickup and after-school events.

utterances.text: Pia: Right, Sunday at the community center — I’m just trying to make sure nobody heads to the porch by mistake. If you’ve heard who’s signed up or what we still need, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center, not the porch. I’m still confirming sign-ups, but setup and check-in are the main things I’m filling right now.

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — could you bring any basic tools you have and help with either appliance or bike repairs? I’ll keep matching folks up at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gloves and screwdrivers still sound like the right tools. With Mina and Gus helping, we should be in good shape for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just confirming, you’re still good to help on Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’m still good to help on Sunday at the community center. I’ll stick to the plan and bring gloves if I can.

utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Hana — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, and it’s now Sunday at the community center. Want me to send you the details or put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring my tools and be there Sunday around 2 at the community center.

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — could you send me the updated Sunday details for the community center? I want to make sure I have the latest before I pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for the details before I share anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll help look over the list and spot any gaps. Just tell me what’s still missing when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll check the list against the donated tools and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules — the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center. Want the details or should I put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for the update — the Sunday community center plan sounds right, and I’d love to keep helping match volunteers. If you need anything passed along, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep sending the Sunday community center details your way. I’ll definitely pass along anything that needs matching up.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll pass along the update and help with check-in when I get there. I’ll also check who’s signed up and whether we still need gloves or screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — that’d be a big help. If you hear whether they still need gloves or screwdrivers, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — once folks start arriving, I’ll point you to the side entrance so we can keep the line moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll stay by the side entrance and help keep the line moving.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thank you — if the boxes start stacking up, I may ask you to shuttle them over so the entrance stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — it’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch. Please help with check-in when you arrive and pass that update along.

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks—that helps. What do you still need me to bring or tell folks about the Sunday repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center, and I’ll ask if anyone can help around 2.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Eli — I’ve got you down for check-in on Sunday at the community center. Thank you, and I’ll send any updates if the plan shifts.

utterances.text: Ira: Yep — I’ll keep mentioning it while I’m out, and remind folks it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — just keep confirming folks are still in for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now and I’ll keep spreading the word that it’s Sunday at the community center.
